title: Wild AG button
description: A pill button with a bold uppercase 13.5px label: paper on bands (turns espresso on hover), a 2px light outline on card panels (fills with paper on hover), or the taupe-to-sand gradient for form submits (darkens to espresso on hover). 0.3s ease.
notes: paper and outline are made for the gradient bands and card panels; gradient for light surfaces
renders an <a> with href, otherwise a <button>
